title: Neuralink's Newest Brain Chip Isn't What You Think

scenes.title: Hook — brain on a plinth
scenes.what: 3D clay-shaded pink brain on a teal plinth, blueprint-dark backdrop. Slow dolly push-in to the implant; a thin lime ring blooms around the chip on the last beat.
scenes.motion: 3D camera push-in (ease-in-out, ~5s); lime highlight ring scale-in

scenes.title: Chip goes x-ray
scenes.what: Same brain; surface material dissolves to translucent so the chip's threads show through.
scenes.motion: Material cross-dissolve opaque→translucent ~0.6s

scenes.title: HUGE* title sequence
scenes.what: Show open: giant cropped HUGE letters push past camera, then the word in 4 colourways (lime/teal, mauve, sage, blue), an asterisk tile pattern, '*if true', ending on lime HUGE* with dark teal extrude on sage.
scenes.motion: Hard cuts every 0.2–0.5s on the music; letters scale-through; extrude offset stays fixed
scenes.type: Ultra-heavy grotesque caps, lime face + dark teal block-shadow extrude; tiny '*if true' lowercase sans

scenes.title: How heavy is a brain?
scenes.what: Head lid flips open, brain floats out onto a glowing plinth; lime label '1.4KG ~3LBS' pops in; comedic rooster for scale; giant white cartoon glove pokes the brain.
scenes.motion: Object pop-out with overshoot; label scale-pop; glove slides in from frame edge
scenes.type: Lime box label, black heavy caps + small sub-unit line

scenes.title: Brain eats blood
scenes.what: X-ray human silhouette, red arteries from heart to brain, '15-20% OF CARDIO OUTPUT' stat; heart pulses with a cyan halo.
scenes.motion: Stat fades + rises in; heart halo pulse loop; camera drift down to heart and back
scenes.type: Big lime numerals (heavy geometric sans) + white tracked small caps

scenes.title: Brain vs computer
scenes.what: Pink brain beside a retro beige Macintosh, dashed lime data along nerve 'cables'; macro keyboard key press; white mannequin reaching for a blue cup, brain x-rayed in.
scenes.motion: Split layout, dashed-line flow loops; match cuts between brain and computer

scenes.title: Neurons firing
scenes.what: Dense dendrite forest, lime electric flashes ripple through; ends cutting to a starfield (scale analogy).
scenes.motion: Fast 0.2–0.4s cuts, glow flicker; fly-through

scenes.title: Wiring becomes highways
scenes.what: Brain in head with blue vessels, cable plug; camera orbits behind the head, nerves become thick cable bundles on a teal blueprint grid.
scenes.motion: Orbit + morph; grid floor establishes the 'highway world' used for the rest of the film

scenes.title: Control room metaphor
scenes.what: Inside the skull is a pink 'CONTROL ROOM' with a tiny operator; cut to a street of mannequins, five pink sense icons (HEAR/SMELL/TASTE/FEEL/SEE) arc over the figure.
scenes.motion: Icons pop in staggered left→right (~3f apart); sign is a 3D extruded object
scenes.type: 3D extruded white caps sign; lime micro-labels over pink icon tiles

scenes.title: Signal path
scenes.what: Glass brain with a lime spark and a white motion-arc; neuron chain macro; lime pulse capsule travels along the cable highway; 'MOVE' label with red pin.
scenes.motion: Light pulse tracks along path (linear); camera follows
scenes.type: White heavy caps label + red triangle pin

scenes.title: Lower third — Dan Adams
scenes.what: Name super over interview: lime asterisk bullet, NAME in white bold caps, role in smaller grey caps.
scenes.motion: Wipe/fade on, ~10f; holds ~3s
scenes.type: White heavy caps + small tracked caps role line; lime * bullet

scenes.title: Realistic brain glow
scenes.what: Photo-real tan brain rotating with a yellow emissive region.
scenes.motion: Slow turntable

scenes.title: Brain regions mapped
scenes.what: Brain turns to glass; regions light up one at a time with leader lines to small label chips (VISUAL CORTEX lime, BROCA'S AREA blue, CORTICAL HAND KNOB red).
scenes.motion: Region glow fade-up then leader line draw-on, label chip pops; sequential
scenes.type: Tiny bold caps on solid colour chips matching region colour

scenes.title: The key = BCIs
scenes.what: Hand knob in red, MOTOR CORTEX label; lime key icon flies in; big lime 'BRAIN' then 'BRAIN-COMPUTER INTERFACES' fills frame over the dimmed brain.
scenes.motion: Key slides in + rotate; words type in word-by-word (hard swap)
scenes.type: Big lime heavy condensed caps with dark outline — the hero-word treatment

scenes.title: Highway of signals
scenes.what: Brain on grid, cable bundle highways, lime capsule pulse, glass brain zoom, 'BEFORE ACTION' label + red pin.
scenes.motion: Long fly-along camera, ease-in-out; pulse linear

scenes.title: Reading the waveform
scenes.what: Sagittal brain in head silhouette, lime nerve path; circular magnifier inset with white waveform.
scenes.motion: Magnifier circle scales in from the nerve point with a cone; waveform scrolls

scenes.title: Where the BCI sits
scenes.what: Pink sagittal brain, lime path to a blue implant labelled 'BRAIN COMPUTER INTERFACE'; lime arrow bobs.
scenes.motion: Line draw-on along path; arrow idle bob

scenes.title: Lower third — DJ Seo
scenes.what: Same lower-third system as S11.
scenes.motion: Wipe/fade on

scenes.title: Chip product shot
scenes.what: Macro product render of the chip with a real finger tapping it.
scenes.motion: Locked camera, shallow DOF

scenes.title: Implant placement
scenes.what: Parts laid out → brain in head with blue motor region and hole → coin implant drops into place.
scenes.motion: Push-in; implant drops with soft ease and settle

scenes.title: Skull = stadium roof
scenes.what: Head skull opens like a stadium roof (lime arrow points), cut through blimp cockpit into the stadium.
scenes.motion: Lid hinge open; arrow draw-on; transition through cockpit window

scenes.title: Stadium on the grid
scenes.what: Top-down 3D stadium on a blue blueprint grid with HUGE* blimp; red counter tags ('8000000') pop around.
scenes.motion: Tags pop in staggered
scenes.type: White numerals on red rounded tags

scenes.title: Blimp fly-in
scenes.what: HUGE* branded blimp sweeps over, camera dives into the bowl.
scenes.motion: Continuous swoop camera, ease-in-out

scenes.title: Signal vs invasiveness chart
scenes.what: Stadium blurs to background; 2D axis diagram draws on: CLEARER/FUZZIER SIGNAL, MORE/LESS INVASIVE, then a dashed trend line with a dot.
scenes.motion: Arrows grow from centre; labels fade-in; dashed line draws; background defocus
scenes.type: Lime and red heavy caps labels at arrow tips

scenes.title: Stentrode in a vessel
scenes.what: Macro brain surface with blue vessels; stent slides inside a vein; cut back to stadium with the chart docked as a corner card.
scenes.motion: Slow macro push; chart shrinks to a picture-in-picture card

scenes.title: Lower third — Rapoport (remote)
scenes.what: Video-call interview with the same lower-third system.
scenes.motion: Fade on

scenes.title: Company render + caption
scenes.what: Third-party medical render with a thin sans caption bottom-left.
scenes.motion: none

scenes.title: Into the stands
scenes.what: Camera flies from seats onto the pitch; diagram card in corner; lime stripe accents.
scenes.motion: FPV fly-in

scenes.title: Players' huddle chatter
scenes.what: Huddle on the pitch; blue glowing speech tags pop above ('LETS GO LONG', 'READY? BREAK!', 'KEEP IT TIGHT').
scenes.motion: Tags pop in staggered
scenes.type: Small blue pill tags, white caps

scenes.title: Utah Array reveal
scenes.what: Spiky electrode array on a curved grid, big lime 'UTAH ARRAY' slams in right.
scenes.motion: Product orbit; text hard-in
scenes.type: Big lime heavy caps, 2 lines, left-aligned

scenes.title: Rewind + chart
scenes.what: Huddle with '◀◀ REW' VHS label, then back to the axis chart with labelled dots along the trend line (Utah Array, Precision, Synchron).
scenes.motion: Rewind speed-ramp; dots pop along line
scenes.type: White caps 'REW' with chevrons; small caps dot labels

scenes.title: THE LINK reveal
scenes.what: Exploded-view device assembles; device sits between 'THE' and 'LINK' in big white caps on dark.
scenes.motion: Parts collapse together (ease-out); words slide in from either side of the object
scenes.type: Huge white heavy caps, device used as a letter-space

scenes.title: Ad — email UI
scenes.what: Sponsor email recreated; lines get lime highlighter swipes; '*AD' lime ring badge top-right.
scenes.motion: Push-in on UI; highlight wipes left→right
scenes.type: Lime highlighter behind black text; '*AD' badge

scenes.title: Ad — dashboard UI
scenes.what: Dark dashboard screens with push-ins, '*AD' badge persistent.
scenes.motion: Crop/zoom moves on screenshots

scenes.title: Ad — URL super
scenes.what: 'MERCURY.COM' lime heavy caps bottom centre over host.
scenes.motion: Pop in
scenes.type: Lime heavy caps with dark shadow

scenes.title: Name callout arrow
scenes.what: Hand-drawn lime arrow + 'DAN' label points at a person.
scenes.motion: Arrow draw-on ~8f

scenes.title: Output side
scenes.what: Implant broadcasts cyan wifi arcs; head-silhouette diagram with OUTPUT/INPUT nodes wired to a laptop then a robot hand.
scenes.motion: Wifi arcs pulse; circuit line draws node to node

scenes.title: Signal highway, chase cam
scenes.what: Lime capsule pulse rides the cable highway.
scenes.motion: Chase camera, constant speed

scenes.title: Input in
scenes.what: Sagittal brain, blue implant, lime arrow; lime signal draws down the spine.
scenes.motion: Line draw-on

scenes.title: Chip x-ray + INPUT IN
scenes.what: Brain goes translucent around the chip; 'INPUT IN' label with lime arrow.
scenes.motion: Material dissolve; arrow pop

scenes.title: Fly down the highway
scenes.what: POV through the cable highway, one lane lights blue.
scenes.motion: Forward dolly; lane glow fade-up

scenes.title: Inputs / outputs / senses
scenes.what: Brain with implants, OUTPUTS/INPUTS tunnels, multicolour sense regions with labels, Mac at the end of a 'MEMORY'/'PROCESSING' data road of coloured blocks.
scenes.motion: Long 32s sequence of orbit + dolly; data blocks stream
scenes.type: White caps tunnel signs; lime caps road labels

scenes.title: Outputs vs Inputs tunnels
scenes.what: Two tunnel mouths labelled OUTPUTS / INPUTS with coloured light-dot traffic; pull out to whole nerve tree.
scenes.motion: Pull-back reveal

scenes.title: Traffic in the tree
scenes.what: Coloured dots stream along branching cables.
scenes.motion: Continuous flow, camera glide

scenes.title: Implant to robot hand
scenes.what: Implant broadcasts; robot hand mirrors the brain's grip.
scenes.motion: Wifi arc loop; hand animates

scenes.title: Closed loop diagram
scenes.what: OUTPUT→robot→INPUT circuit draws around head silhouette, coloured dots run the loop.
scenes.motion: Circuit line draw-on then dot flow

scenes.title: Superpowers lanes
scenes.what: New lanes light up; pink icon tiles flip in with lime labels: SUPER HEARING, INFRARED VISION, SUPER SMELLING, KUNG FU SKILLS.
scenes.motion: Tiles flip/pop in staggered left→right
scenes.type: Lime heavy caps micro-labels above pink tiles

scenes.title: Broken road → spinal injury
scenes.what: Red warning triangle on a broken highway; mannequin can't reach the cup (red 'no' sign).
scenes.motion: Warning pulses; hard cut

scenes.title: Blocked signal
scenes.what: Lime signal path down the spine stops at a red break.
scenes.motion: Line draw then red X pop

scenes.title: Motor cortex → walking
scenes.what: Red motor cortex + lime 'MOTOR CORTEX' label; walker figure with OUTPUT/INPUT circuit; circular zoom inset on leg stimulator.
scenes.motion: Inset circle scales in; circuit draws

scenes.title: Visual cortex
scenes.what: Implant over the back of the brain; region pops red; 'VISUAL CORTEX' lime caps.
scenes.motion: Region extrudes/pops; text hard-in

scenes.title: Implant → robot hand loop
scenes.what: Recap of S45/S46.
scenes.motion: Same as S46

scenes.title: Bridge over the gap
scenes.what: A bridge builds over the broken highway; loading ring then lime check-mark.
scenes.motion: Bridge segments lay down left→right; ring spin → check pop

scenes.title: End card
scenes.what: Split screen: dark teal left with credits/next video, sage right with lime HUGE* logo, 'TO SUPPORT HUGE* IF TRUE, PLEASE CONSIDER SUBSCRIBING.' and Cleo avatar in lime ring between bouncing lime arrows.
scenes.motion: Credits fade; arrows bob in toward avatar
scenes.type: Heavy caps logo; small bold caps body
